title: Deposits and Diary Space Held at Agreement Level — Private Event & Banquet Services
content:
Deposits and diary space on a Private Event & Banquet Services agreement are held at the level of the agreement rather than the single booking, and both are read across every booking the agreement carries.

## Diary space

An agreement may carry no more than the number of confirmed unserved events printed against its package at any one time, counted across every venue date in the diary, and a further booking is offered the next available date instead.

## Deposit money

1. Money held on deposit is tracked booking by booking, and a deposit taken for one event is never applied to another event's bill without the client's written instruction; where such an instruction is on file, the transfer is recorded as an application on the first booking and a fresh deposit on the second.
2. Where a final bill leaves deposit money over, the surplus is returned rather than carried forward, unless another booking on the same agreement is due inside thirty days and the client asks in writing for it to be carried.
3. Deposits held against bookings that have neither been delivered nor cancelled are the client's money and are never set against arrears on another bill.

## Basis questions the clause answers

*On what the thirty days are measured against.* The carry-forward window of 30 days runs to the day the other booking on the same agreement is due, and the written request from the client is required as well; neither on its own carries the surplus forward.

*On money held for an event still to come.* Deposit money standing against a booking that has been neither delivered nor cancelled remains the client's, whatever else the agreement owes.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

An agreement whose package prints a diary allowance of 8 already carries 8 confirmed unserved events. A ninth date is offered as the next available date rather than confirmed. Were three of those events already delivered, five would stand unserved and the ninth date could be confirmed.
